data.name: SHEEP HAPPENS
data.detailed_description:
The ranch has one rule: nothing goes according to plan.

This is coop multiplayer for 2 to 4 players, and every match the game decides who's who — one of you holds the ranch together, the rest exist purely to take it apart. You've got work piling up and a ranch that needs you. Should be easy enough. Except there's a pack of wolves out there, and their only goal in life is making sure you never get a single thing done.

Playing a wolf means you don't have a job — you ARE the problem. Whatever the Rancher's trying to bring, fix, or finish, that's exactly what you're there to wreck. Dig holes where they'll hurt most. Hide where he'd least expect it. Set traps, break stuff, cause absolute mayhem. There's no clean way to do it, and that's the point.

Don't get too comfortable out there, though. The Rancher's got tools of his own and he is NOT in the mood. Get sloppy, get close, and you might just get launched clean off the map.

Every match throws something new at you, and you never know which side of it you'll be on. Nobody's job looks the same twice. Someone's always panicking, someone's always laughing, and somebody's always getting flung across a field.

Features:

Play together with 1 to 3 friends, any group size welcome

Roles assigned by the game each match, so nobody settles into a routine

A rancher with real objectives and real tools to defend them

A pack of wolves built to stop those objectives cold

Tasks that shift constantly, keeping every round unpredictable

A scoring system where every move counts, for both sides
